title: Aperiodic Jammed Packings
statement: Find aperiodic jammed packings in $\mathbb{R}^2$. In $\mathbb{R}^3,$ find a saturated jammed maximal packing that is aperiodic in all directions.
source_name: AimPL: Soft packings, nested clusters, and condensed matter (posed by Musin)

title: Delone Sets (problem 2)
statement: For $d \ge 4$, given a Delone set $(R,r)$ for which all $2R$- clusters are pairwise congruent, find upper bound on the order of the symmetry group of the clusters which does not depend on $R/r$.
source_name: AimPL: Soft packings, nested clusters, and condensed matter (posed by Dolbilin)

title: Can we find bordered generating function models for arboreal singularities?
statement: Can we find bordered generating function models for arboreal singularities?
source_name: AimPL: Arborealization of singularities of Lagrangian skeleta

title: Liouville sectors (problem 3)
statement: Find a geometric description of the adjoint of the functor $\mathcal{W}(X)\to\mathcal{W}(X')$ for an inclusion $X\hookrightarrow X'$ of Liouville sectors.
source_name: AimPL: Arborealization of singularities of Lagrangian skeleta

title: Liouville sectors (problem 4)
statement: Construct the embedding $\mathcal{W}(X)\otimes\mathcal{W}(X')\to\mathcal{W}(X\times X')$ for $X,X'$ Liouville sectors.
source_name: AimPL: Arborealization of singularities of Lagrangian skeleta

title: Evolution of Coherent States on SU(2)
statement: Determine the quantum evolution in the semiclassical limit of initial coherent states on SU(2) with a Hamiltonian that is either non-Hermitian or nonlinear in the Lie algebra generators.
source_name: AimPL: Non-Hermitian quantum mechanics and symplectic geometry

title: Monge-Ampère equations (problem 3)
statement:
For $u$ strictly convex, determine the existence and regularity of solutions to 

$$
\mathrm{det}(D^2 u) u^{ij}u_i u_j = 1.
$$
source_name: AimPL: Nonlinear PDEs in real and complex geometry (posed by Tristan Collins)

title: Find conditions that allow for … regularity for degenerate Monge-Ampère equation (both real and complex).
statement: Find conditions that allow for $C^2$ regularity for degenerate Monge-Ampère equation (both real and complex).
source_name: AimPL: Nonlinear PDEs in real and complex geometry (posed by Xu-Jia Wang)

title: Find a toric proof of the toric case of the orbifold compactness theorem proved by Chen-Weber.
statement: Find a toric proof of the toric case of the orbifold compactness theorem proved by Chen-Weber.
source_name: AimPL: Nonlinear PDEs in real and complex geometry (posed by Heather Macbeth)

title: Discrete geometry and automorphic forms (problem 5)
statement: Prove $A_2$ is universally optimal. Or find magic function for the sphere packing poblem in $\mathbb R^2$.
source_name: AimPL: Discrete geometry and automorphic forms (posed by Musin/Cohn)

title: Geodesic Flows on Compact Spaces (problem 2)
statement: Let $\varphi_t$ be geodesic flow on the unit tangent bundle of a compact surface of constant negative curvature. Let $S_n$ denote the number of simple closed geodesics with length $\le n$. Find precise growth rates for $S_n$. More generally, what can be said about variable negative curvature?
source_name: AimPL: Equilibrium states for dynamical systems arising from geometry (posed by Jayadev Athreya)

title: Specific Examples (problem 1)
statement: Let $\varphi_1,\varphi_2: X \to {\\mathbb{R}}$ be two potentials. What interesting analysis can be said about the 2-parameter family of equilibrium states $\mu_{q_1\varphi_1 + q_2\varphi_2}$? Can we find useful applications for these results?
source_name: AimPL: Equilibrium states for dynamical systems arising from geometry (posed by Keith Burns)

title: Can one find a simplified proof of Burns-Gelfert in using, possibly with stronger conclusions?
statement: Can one find a simplified proof of Burns-Gelfert in using, possibly with stronger conclusions? Similarly for the results of Paulin-Policott-Schapira in.
source_name: AimPL: Equilibrium states for dynamical systems arising from geometry (posed by Keith Burns)

title: Other Directions (problem 1)
statement: Let $f_1,f_2$ be commuting hyperbolic diffeomorphisms of a compact manifold $M$. One may construct coarse Lyapunov foliations $\mathcal W$. Given a potential $\varphi$, can one construct leaf-wise conditional measures $\mu^{\mathcal W}_\varphi$ which satisfy Margulis-like cocycle properties?
source_name: AimPL: Equilibrium states for dynamical systems arising from geometry (posed by Kurt Vinhage)

title: Other Directions (problem 2)
statement: For metric Anosov flows (Smale flows), under what conditions does orbit equivalence imply H\"older orbit equivalence? Can one find a Smale flow which is not H\"older covered by the suspension of a symbolic dynamical system.
source_name: AimPL: Equilibrium states for dynamical systems arising from geometry (posed by Dan Thompson)

title: Can one find a dynamical interpretation of the pressure gap?
statement: Can one find a dynamical interpretation of the pressure gap? For instance, can one relate the pressure gap to an essential spectral radius for a dynamical operator? Or some dynamically defined $\zeta$-function?
source_name: AimPL: Equilibrium states for dynamical systems arising from geometry (posed by Jerome Buzzi)

title: Other Directions (problem 8)
statement: Consider a finite-horizon billiards, and let $\varphi$ be the geometric potential. Is there a jump in pressure $P(q\varphi)$ and $q \to 0^-$? Can one find perioidic orbits with arbitrarily large (but finite) Lyapunov exponent?
source_name: AimPL: Equilibrium states for dynamical systems arising from geometry (posed by Mark Demers)

title: Maximum Contacts in Disk Packing
statement: Find a collection of $n$ objects (e.g. disks of given radii) such that all packings have $k$ contacts where $k$ is $\leq$ the number required for isostaticity for that object but there exists a rigid packing that has a non-trivial infinitesimal flex and an equilibrium stress.
source_name: AimPL: Rigidity and flexibility of microstructures (posed by Miranda Holmes-Cerfon)

title: Determine which … -regular graphs are independent in the generic 3-dimensional rigidity matroid.
statement: Determine which $k$-regular graphs are independent in the generic 3-dimensional rigidity matroid.
source_name: AimPL: Rigidity and flexibility of microstructures (posed by Tony Nixon)

title: Find an appropriate definition of Morse functions on Alexandrov spaces and construct examples.
statement: Find an appropriate definition of Morse functions on Alexandrov spaces and construct examples.
source_name: AimPL: Manifolds with non-negative sectional curvature

title: Collapse and Alexandrov Geometry (problem 10)
statement: Given a non-collapsing Gromov-Hausdorff convergence $M_i \longrightarrow X$, can one find a “tangent bundle” structure on $X$ that is sensitive to the diffeomorphism class of the $M_i$?
source_name: AimPL: Manifolds with non-negative sectional curvature

title: Find an application where infinite-dimensional Alexandrov spaces appear as limits of manifolds of increasing dimension.
statement: Find an application where infinite-dimensional Alexandrov spaces appear as limits of manifolds of increasing dimension.
source_name: AimPL: Manifolds with non-negative sectional curvature

title: Find cohomogeneity-one manifolds with “interesting” topology, in particular not homeomorphic to a symmetric space.
statement: Find cohomogeneity-one manifolds with “interesting” topology, in particular not homeomorphic to a symmetric space. Study curvature properties of these manifolds.
source_name: AimPL: Manifolds with non-negative sectional curvature

title: Manifolds of Cohomogeneity-one and Polar Actions (problem 4)
statement: Compute topological invariants of cohomogeneity-one manifolds. Classify topologically the new candidates for positive curvature.
source_name: AimPL: Manifolds with non-negative sectional curvature

title: Find new examples of fundamental groups in quasi-positive curvature or positive curvature on an open dense set.
statement: Find new examples of fundamental groups in quasi-positive curvature or positive curvature on an open dense set.
source_name: AimPL: Manifolds with non-negative sectional curvature

title: Minimum of slabs of the cube $B^n_\infty$
statement: There are numbers $t_1$ and $t_2$ such that for $2\sqrt{2}-2 < t < t_1$, the minimum is in the direction of $(1,1,0,\ldots,0)$; for $t_1 < t < t_2$, the minimum is in the direction of $(1,1,1,0,\ldots,0)$ and for $t_2 < t$, the minimum is in the direction of $(1,1,\ldots,1)$.
source_name: AimPL: Fourier analytic methods in convex geometry

title: The Problems (problem 19)
statement:
Given $n+1$ points $x_1,\ldots, x_{n+1}$ on $S^{n-1}$, find the configuration such that the convex hull of $x_1,\ldots, x_{n+1}$
has the largest mean width. Is it maximal for the regular simplex?
source_name: AimPL: Fourier analytic methods in convex geometry

title: Steinberg Modules & Homology (problem 3)
statement: Compute homology of $SK$-automorphism groups of manifolds.
source_name: AimPL: Scissors congruences, algebraic K-theory and Steinberg modules

title: Can M2 compute the exceptional collection constructed in the work of Favero, Ballard, Katzarkov?
statement: Can M2 compute the exceptional collection constructed in the work of Favero, Ballard, Katzarkov?
source_name: AimPL: Homological mirror symmetry and multigraded commutative algebra (posed by Juliette Bruce)

title: Clarifying and Expanding Toric Mirror Symmetry (problem 2)
statement: Given a choice of a mirror skeleton, one can consider its canonical probe generators. What is the geometric meaning of the mutated collection of these generators? Can we find another skeleton for the same symplectic manifold, whose canonical generators are the mutated collection?
source_name: AimPL: Homological mirror symmetry and multigraded commutative algebra (posed by Jeff Hicks)

title: Can we find algebraic cycles (living in characteristic … ), which account for such Tate classes?
statement: Can we find algebraic cycles (living in characteristic $p$), which account for such Tate classes?
source_name: AimPL: The Tate Conjecture (posed by J. Ellenberg, D. Ulmer)

title: Representations (problem 2)
statement: Construct supercuspidal representations of $\widetilde{G}_{F}$.
source_name: AimPL: Automorphic forms on covering groups (posed by W. Gan)

title: Fundamental properties (problem 1)
statement: Determine notion of stable conjugacy when stable conjugacy classes in $\widetilde{G}_F$ and $\widetilde{H}_L$ naturally are related.
source_name: AimPL: Automorphic forms on covering groups (posed by W. Gan)

title: Covering group of tori
statement:
Let $T$ be a (not necessary split) torus over a $p$--adic field. Construct $\widetilde{T}$

$$
1 \longrightarrow \mu_F \longrightarrow \widetilde{T}
\longrightarrow T \longrightarrow 1
$$

explicitly within Brylinski-Deligne framework.
source_name: AimPL: Automorphic forms on covering groups (posed by M. Weissman and S. Lysenko)

title: Is there an index theoretic interpretation of elliptic genus?
statement: Is there an index theoretic interpretation of elliptic genus? When it can, how do we compute it and what is the geometric interpretation of the coefficients? Check that this matches CFT calculations.
source_name: AimPL: Gromov-Witten invariants and number theory

title: Specific functions (problem 2)
statement: Do the coefficients of $h_m$ have enumerative significance? Can we find $h_m$ for $m \geq 9$?
source_name: AimPL: Gromov-Witten invariants and number theory

title: Determine the connection between Mock modular forms and geometric invariants like Gromov-Witten, Donaldson, and OSV conjecture.
statement: Determine the connection between Mock modular forms and geometric invariants like Gromov-Witten, Donaldson, and OSV conjecture.
source_name: AimPL: Gromov-Witten invariants and number theory

title: Find classes of examples of polynomials or rational maps … for which we can compute explicitly the arboreal Galois representation up to finite index over various fields.
statement: Find classes of examples of polynomials or rational maps $d\geq 3$ for which we can compute explicitly the arboreal Galois representation up to finite index over various fields.
source_name: AimPL: The Galois theory of orbits in arithmetic dynamics (posed by Jones, Manes)

title: Generalizing: Can you find an example in higher dimensions?
statement: Generalizing: Can you find an example in higher dimensions?
source_name: AimPL: The Galois theory of orbits in arithmetic dynamics

title: Pair correlation (problem 2)
statement: Compute the $3$-point correlation function $R_3(x_1,x_2,x_3)$ for zeta rigorously under suitable hypotheses (e.g. Hardy-Littlewood conjecture for twin primes).
source_name: AimPL: Moments of zeta and correlations of divisor sums (posed by J. Keating)

title: Compute the … -point correlation function rigorously under suitable hypotheses (here, Type II terms come in).
statement: Compute the $4$-point correlation function rigorously under suitable hypotheses (here, Type II terms come in).
source_name: AimPL: Moments of zeta and correlations of divisor sums (posed by J. Keating)

title: Develop a heuristic for … Find connections with the work of Bogomolny-Keating and with the Ratios Conjectures.
statement:
Develop a heuristic for

$$
\int_T^{2T} \left| \sum_{p\leq X} \frac{1}{p^{1/2+it}}\right|^{2k} \,dt.
$$

Find connections with the work of Bogomolny-Keating and with the Ratios Conjectures.
source_name: AimPL: Moments of zeta and correlations of divisor sums (posed by A. Harper)

title: Structure in$~(A+B)\cdot (C+D)$ (problem 2)
statement: Find a quantitative version of the second theorem above (i.e. express the index of the subgroup in terms of the Banach density of $A$).
source_name: AimPL: Nonstandard methods in combinatorial number theory (posed by Alexander Fish)

title: Construct a PKE scheme from hardness of discrete-log problem in a specific group.
statement: Construct a PKE scheme from hardness of discrete-log problem in a specific group.
source_name: AimPL: Constructing cryptographic multilinear maps (posed by Sanjam Garg)

title: Can we construct local pseudorandom number generators from algebraic methods?
statement: Can we construct local pseudorandom number generators from algebraic methods?
source_name: AimPL: Constructing cryptographic multilinear maps (posed by Rachel Lin)

title: Can we construct a bilinear pairing which takes values in E(Fq) where the source groups are also Discrete-Log-Hard?
statement: Can we construct a bilinear pairing which takes values in E(F_q) where the source groups are also Discrete-Log-Hard?
source_name: AimPL: Constructing cryptographic multilinear maps (posed by Kristin Lauter)

title: Can we construct multilinear maps from supersingular isogeny graphs?
statement: Can we construct multilinear maps from supersingular isogeny graphs?
source_name: AimPL: Constructing cryptographic multilinear maps (posed by Kristin Lauter)

title: When can you find algebraically defined multilinear maps involving group schemes of p-power order?
statement: When can you find algebraically defined multilinear maps involving group schemes of p-power order?
source_name: AimPL: Constructing cryptographic multilinear maps (posed by Ted Chinburg)

title: Can we get multilinear maps from cohomological constructions?
statement: Can we get multilinear maps from cohomological constructions? In particular, there is a natural multiplication map from $A[\ell]^{2g}$ into $\mu_\ell^{\otimes g}$ essentially given by the wedge-product structure. Can we find a way to get better target group?
source_name: AimPL: Constructing cryptographic multilinear maps (posed by Huang)

title: Find an algorithm for the approximate-gcd problem for general parameters.
statement:
Find an algorithm for the approximate-gcd problem for general parameters. In particular, given a set of integers $\{n_i=qp_i+r_i\}$ where the $r_i$ are small, find q in polynomial time. 

As one example, what if r has $\ell-1$ bits, q has $\ell$ bits, and p has $\ell^2$ bits.
source_name: AimPL: Constructing cryptographic multilinear maps (posed by Nadia Heninger)
